<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> The Lok Sabha is set to introduce the Kashmiri Pandits Rehabilitation Bill and take up the MSME Development (Amendment) Bill during the ongoing Monsoon Session.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Quota policy:</strong> The government has informed the Supreme Court that the decision to extend the &quot;creamy layer&quot; exclusion to SC/ST categories rests with Parliament, while simultaneously arguing against such exclusions for these groups.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Energy infrastructure:</strong> The Union Cabinet approved the INR 23,731 crore GOBARdhan scheme to increase Compressed Biogas (CBG) production and reduce reliance on LNG imports.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election administration:</strong> The Election Commission of India concluded a National Round Table Conference with State Election Commissioners to discuss electoral processes and institutional coordination.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNQXdyYk1aZXAxQkp5UVZZRjM0VUJiY1BTQTA3alVkY2tsQzJ4MnhyWTNhR3YxekxlX1hKM0tHcmxCSDVrbGd5eGVYYmhmQkhRZEZhd0R2OU02aFlnSk9Yc0lUN3l5dkVJNFZ1ajBlOUZtamN4YjZEaWU3dkNiYTN1SnR5VkdxajJZWmJaNVR1UjhnbEhOZHVfaTlqekxfQXdsN29UQmRvT2ZPUkpHb0Zj?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
